symptom: A search performed by the user does not appear in the VII administration search surfaces.
expected_behavior: The signed-in administrator can see the performed search as an internal test, while public-demand figures remain unaffected.
environment: Production VII administration before deployment of the current release branch, with the user signed in and the browser consent choice unknown.

reproduction.evidence: User observed the performed search was absent from the live administration system.

observations.observation: Client search capture returns without a request unless vii-cookie-choice equals all.
Authenticated administrator events are stored as internal and excluded from the existing aggregate report.
The current analytics page has no recent internal-search inventory.

hypotheses.mechanism: The administrator browser did not grant full analytics consent, so the client sent no event.
hypotheses.prediction: The source contains an early return before the request and no server-side admin exception can run.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect the event producer and simulate consent values.
hypotheses.result: The producer returns immediately unless consent is all.

hypotheses.mechanism: The event is stored but intentionally hidden because it belongs to an administrator.
hypotheses.prediction: Internal rows exist but the report queries internal = 0 and the UI has no internal list.
hypotheses.result: The save path marks administrators internal, while readSearchAnalytics filters all aggregates to internal = 0.

hypotheses.mechanism: Only the specific search world lacks an event producer.
hypotheses.prediction: One world result component would not call trackSearchResults.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect all four result families and run source coverage tests.
hypotheses.result: All four result families call trackSearchResults on the current release branch.

fix.change: The client now asks the ingestion route for admin eligibility before discarding a no-consent search, the route stores only authenticated no-consent searches as internal tests, and the report exposes separate recent public and internal inventories sourced from detailed demand events.
fix.evidence: Focused search analytics tests passed 18/18, including no-consent administrator retention, anonymous no-consent discard, and public/internal separation; the full repository suite passed 658/658 and TypeScript completed without errors.

regression_checks.check: Unauthenticated visitors without analytics consent do not create search demand rows.
regression_checks.evidence: Focused route tests verify searchCaptureMode returns discard and the ingestion route responds without storage for non-admin no-consent events.

regression_checks.check: Authenticated administrator searches remain excluded from public demand and zero-result totals.
regression_checks.evidence: Focused report tests verify internal rows appear only in recentInternal while public totals, unique sessions and zero-result counts use internal = 0.

regression_checks.check: Vacation, event, spa and hourly result families retain detailed search tracking.
regression_checks.evidence: Source coverage assertions and the full 658-test suite verify all four search result families still call trackSearchResults.

regression_checks.check: The administration report exposes actionable recent rows and direct opportunity editing links.
regression_checks.evidence: UI source tests verify public/internal mode controls, search filters, result counts, timestamps, opportunity status and /admin/search-pages?id= links.

regression_checks.check: The application builds and type-checks after the schema and report changes.
regression_checks.evidence: pnpm test completed with 658 passed and 0 failed; pnpm exec tsc --noEmit completed successfully.

remaining_unknowns: The exact consent choice attached to the historical missing production search cannot be reconstructed because the previous client discarded it before any server request.
authorization_boundary: The repair is implemented and locally verified; production completion remains conditional on deployment and exact live-route verification.
